43:11.text: from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth

43:12.text: And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride:

43:13.text: In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the Favour of your Lord when you mount thereon, and say: "Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it

43:14.text: And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return!"

43:15.text: Yet, they assign to some of His slaves a share with Him
(by pretending that He has children, and considering them as equals or co-partners in worship with Him)
. Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate!

43:16.text: Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons?

43:17.text: And if one of them is informed of the news of
that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious
, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief!

43:18.text: a creature who is brought up in adornments
(wearing silk and gold ornaments, i.e. women)
, and who in dispute cannot make herself clear?

43:19.text: And they make the angels who themselves are slaves of the Most Gracious
females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned!

43:20.text: And they said: "If it had been the Will of the Most Gracious
, we should not have worshipped them
." They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do nothing but lie!

43:21.text: Or have We given them any Book before this
to which they are holding fast?

43:22.text: Nay! They say: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps."
